findings.summary: The official TWS API 10.48 artifact filename, origin, version, SHA-256, license and redistribution terms, transitive dependencies, Python 3.12 compatibility, and compatible TWS/Gateway build are not independently accepted.
Authoritative paper-session proof, exactly-one-account handling, account ambiguity blocking, and transient private data containment are not independently accepted.
The dedicated client ID, persistent order-ID allocation, opaque order references, durable outbox, dispatch ambiguity, restart recovery, and idempotency design are not independently accepted.
Callback ordering, duplicate and conflict handling, fill correlation, bracket sequencing, expected protection, and missing-protection blocking are not independently accepted.
Disconnect, reconnect, reader failure, retrieval-window gaps, callback replay, position comparison, and reconciliation-before-new-risk behavior are not independently accepted.
Local-only destination enforcement, no-public-exposure evidence, private data redaction, and fail-closed handling of account ambiguity are not independently accepted.
The local no-op alert limitation, missing-protection escalation, emergency-stop behavior, and operator response procedure are not independently accepted.
No independent architecture, trading-safety, or security reviewer has accepted the exact Candidate 062 design, its P0/P1 resolutions, or its residual risks.

traceability.requirement: A future connector must isolate SDK lifecycle, reader, queue, and failure states behind the adapter and fail closed.
Candidate 063 must pin one official API 10.48 artifact with verified digest, license, dependencies, and compatibility before implementation.
Paper proof, exactly-one-account handling, transient sensitive data, and local-only destination checks must remain fail closed.
Outbox, callback, status, fill, disconnect, reconnect, rejection, and reconciliation decisions must be durable, correlated, typed, sanitized, and append-only.
No future paper request may bypass risk, approval, OMS, protection, emergency, idempotency, connection, and reconciliation gates.
Alert limitations, emergency response, rollback, recovery, and any future lab remain explicit human-gated blockers.
The review must bind to exact source and must not promote internal preparation, tests, adapter seams, or documentation to external evidence.
Stale data, duplicate identity, unknown state, missing protection, or reconciliation ambiguity must block risk-increasing progression and live trading remains prohibited.
